g.title: None.None.Node.24
g.text: The browser requests the site from CloudFront
CloudFront serves HTML, JavaScript and images from the S3 static site
API calls go to the Application Load Balancer in either availability zone
The load balancer forwards the call to an EC2 app server in a private subnet
The app server reads the customer's session from ElastiCache
It reads and writes application data in Aurora PostgreSQL
The app server fetches database credentials through the Secrets Manager interface endpoint
User uploads are stored in S3 through the gateway endpoint
